content.text:
You can order a birthday cake online from a few good types of places, depending on how soon you need it:

**Fast / same-day delivery**
- **Instacart** — order cakes from nearby grocery stores like Publix, Costco, Safeway, Kroger, etc., depending on your ZIP code. Good for same-day or next-day cakes. ([instacart.com](https://www.instacart.com/store/s?k=birthday+cakes&utm_source=openai))
- **Local grocery store bakery websites** — Walmart, Whole Foods, Publix, Kroger, Safeway/Albertsons, Costco, Sam’s Club, etc. Many allow online cake ordering for pickup, and some support delivery via partners.

**Nationwide shipping**
- **Goldbelly** — ships birthday cakes from well-known bakeries around the U.S.; good for specialty cakes and gifts. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?irgwc=1&utm_source=openai))
- **Milk Bar** — popular for birthday cake, cake truffles, and other desserts; offers nationwide shipping and some local on-demand delivery. ([milkbarstore.com](https://milkbarstore.com/pages/delivery?utm_source=openai))
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — specializes in nationwide birthday cake delivery and gift cakes. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Custom/local cakes**
- Search **“custom birthday cake delivery near me”** or use local bakeries on **DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Yelp, Google Maps**, or bakery websites.

If you need it **today**, try **Instacart or a local grocery bakery** first. If it’s for a later date and you want something more special, try **Goldbelly, Milk Bar, or a local custom bakery**.
